evidence_required: actual project source or runtime HTTP when consented
domains.pass: Indexable intended pages are technically accessible and no confirmed crawl/index blocker remains.
domains.issue: A confirmed technical requirement is violated on an intended indexable surface.

evidence_required: source inspection and/or rendered evidence for behavior-sensitive findings
domains.pass: Required semantic structure is supported by evidence with no material confirmed issue.

evidence_required: code evidence for static rules; runtime evidence for interaction claims when consented
domains.pass: Applicable WCAG checks are evidenced and no material confirmed violation remains.
domains.issue: One or more material conformance failures are evidenced.

evidence_required: source code and rendered head where runtime is available/approved
domains.pass: Important indexable routes have coherent metadata without confirmed conflicts.
domains.issue: Material title/description/robots/social metadata defect is evidenced.

evidence_required: actual URL rules and source/rendered evidence as applicable
domains.pass: Canonical signals are coherent for duplicate/variant URL families.
domains.issue: Conflicting or materially incorrect canonical signals are evidenced.

domains.applies_when: all web projects with structured data or relevant page types
domains.pass: Implemented structured data is syntactically valid, semantically appropriate, and current for the claimed feature.
domains.issue: Markup is invalid, mismatched, unsupported, or materially misleading.

domains.applies_when: all web projects intended for crawling/indexing
evidence_required: file/source inspection and runtime endpoint evidence when approved
domains.pass: Crawler controls and sitemap coverage are coherent and do not block intended pages.
domains.issue: Confirmed crawl-control or sitemap defect exists.

evidence_required: project graph plus source inspection; crawl evidence when available
domains.pass: Important pages are discoverable through crawlable links with sensible hierarchy.
domains.issue: Orphaning, non-crawlable navigation, or materially poor architecture is evidenced.

evidence_required: field data when available; lab data labeled; code findings require causal evidence
domains.pass: No confirmed performance issue against the selected measurement method remains.
domains.issue: Material performance issue is evidenced with measurable or causal support.

evidence_required: product/catalog source and structured data consistency
domains.pass: Applicable ecommerce surfaces are coherent and evidence-backed.

evidence_required: content/source evidence; clearly distinguish official behavior from emerging practice
domains.pass: Content is technically eligible and materially clear/useful for retrieval without unsupported AI-search claims.
domains.issue: Confirmed discoverability/clarity/trust defect exists or the site makes unsupported AI-search claims that require correction.

evidence_required: version-matched official docs plus actual code
domains.pass: Version-appropriate Next.js behavior is implemented coherently for audited surfaces.
domains.issue: A confirmed version-specific or framework integration defect exists.

evidence_required: code/config/advisory evidence; runtime only when approved
domains.pass: Applicable security attack surfaces have no confirmed material defect within audit scope.
domains.issue: A concrete security vulnerability or materially unsafe configuration is evidenced.

evidence_required: command exit codes and output references
domains.pass: All applicable validation gates have terminal results and no claimed fix lacks required verification.
domains.issue: A required validation gate failed or a fix remains unverified.
